instructions.instruction: Define Preconditions, Postconditions, and Class Invariants.
instructions.original_snippets: Define Preconditions, Postconditions, and Class Invariants.
instructions.relevant_when: When designing a new function or data structure.

instructions.instruction: Reject defensive programming: If a precondition is specified, the supplier must assume it is true. Do not add redundant checks.
instructions.original_snippets: Reject defensive programming. If a precondition is specified, the supplier must assume it is true. Do not add redundant checks.
instructions.relevant_when: When implementing a function that has a specified contract.

instructions.instruction: Restore class invariants before resumption or triggering an 'organized panic' in exception handling.
instructions.original_snippets: Restore class invariants before resumption or triggering an 'organized panic'.
instructions.relevant_when: When handling exceptions or errors that could leave objects in an inconsistent state.

instructions.instruction: Apply Hoare Triples {P} C {Q} to specify code blocks.
instructions.original_snippets: Apply {P} C {Q} to specify code blocks.
instructions.relevant_when: When documenting or specifying the behavior of a segment of code.

instructions.instruction: Use wp(C, Q) to derive the weakest precondition from your postcondition (backward construction).
instructions.original_snippets: Use wp(C, Q) to derive the weakest precondition from your postcondition.
instructions.relevant_when: When constructing code to satisfy a specific goal (postcondition).

instructions.instruction: Use the Assignment Rule: wp('x := E', R) = R[x -> E].
instructions.original_snippets: Assignment Rule: wp("x := E", R) = R[x -> E].
instructions.relevant_when: When calculating the precondition for a variable assignment.

instructions.instruction: Use Sequential Composition: wp('S1; S2', R) = wp(S1, wp(S2, R)).
instructions.original_snippets: Sequential Composition: wp("S1; S2", R) = wp(S1, wp(S2, R)).
instructions.relevant_when: When calculating the precondition for a sequence of statements.

instructions.instruction: Define a Loop Invariant (I) that must hold before, during, and after the loop.
instructions.original_snippets: Invariant (I): Must hold before, during, and after the loop. (I AND NOT B) => Q.

instructions.instruction: Define a Loop Variant (v) as a strictly decreasing non-negative integer function ensuring termination.
instructions.original_snippets: Variant (v): Strictly decreasing non-negative integer function ensuring termination.
instructions.relevant_when: When implementing a loop to ensure it finishes.
When verifying a loop is correctly set up.

instructions.instruction: Prove loop Preservation ({I AND B} Body {I}).
instructions.relevant_when: When verifying a loop's body maintains the invariant.

instructions.instruction: Prove loop Termination (v decreases, I => v >= 0).
instructions.relevant_when: When verifying a loop will always terminate.

instructions.instruction: Annotate using language-native assertions to document the contract.
instructions.original_snippets: Annotate: Use language-native assertions (e.g., assert in Python, @requires/@ensures in Eiffel/JML) to document the contract.
instructions.relevant_when: When finalizing the implementation of a function or class.

instructions.instruction: Embed assert statements within the loop body to verify the Invariant and Variant at each iteration.
instructions.original_snippets: Embed assert statements within the loop body to verify the Invariant and Variant at each iteration.
instructions.relevant_when: When implementing a loop for runtime verification.

instructions.instruction: When restoring state in an exception handler, use established property setters or call the class invariant check immediately after restoration.
instructions.original_snippets: When restoring state in an exception handler, use established property setters or call the class invariant check immediately after restoration to ensure a validated state.
instructions.relevant_when: When performing a rollback in exception handling.
